edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.mechanism: This factor is studied as a modifier of physiologic reserve through protein synthesis signaling, mitochondrial stress responses, substrate timing, senescent-cell burden, or heat and cardiorespiratory adaptation. For Dementia (all-cause), the key distinction is whether the evidence reflects durable functional change or only short-term biomarker movement.
edges.summary: In middle-aged adults, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that regular sauna use tracks with lower risk of dementia (all-cause). Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
